name: unmassk-design
description: Multi-branch design toolkit. Sourced from Impeccable (pbakaus), UI/UX Pro Max (nextlevelbuilder), bencium-marketplace, Emil Kowalski, claudedesignskills (freshtechbro), taste-skill (leonxlnx), Motion.dev, css-animation, and Flutter UI skills.
